landing.eyebrow: Open source · Local first · Zero knowledge
landing.title: Your authenticator, on your terms.
landing.description: Start with a fully local TOTP Vault. Move to encrypted personal or governed shared Vaults only when you choose.

comparison.title: What is rhasia-scret?
comparison.description: rhasia-scret is a TOTP authenticator built around a choice: keep your codes entirely local, then explicitly copy them to encrypted personal or shared Vaults only when that helps.

flow.title: One authenticator, on your terms
flow.description: Use the devices you prefer to protect the services you use. rhasia-scret keeps each account in the Vault you choose.
flow.vault: Your encrypted Local, Personal, or Shared Vault

localFirst.title: Local-first
localFirst.description: Start and keep codes in a writable Local Vault on your device. Nothing moves until you choose.

zeroKnowledge.title: Zero knowledge
zeroKnowledge.description: Hosted Vault content is encrypted before it reaches the service; readable names, labels, settings, and OTPs remain in your browser.

flow.accountsDescription: Example layout only; your actual labels remain encrypted.

shared.label: Workspace · team
shared.detail: For a family or coworker group

flow.note: This is not a silent sync path: moving an account between Vaults is always an explicit action.

codes.label: OTP codes
codes.googleAuthenticator: Offline codes kept in the authenticator app.
codes.otherAuthenticatorApps: Offline codes, with workflows set by each app.
codes.rhasiaScret: Offline codes in a writable Local Vault—no sign-in required.

ownership.label: Starting point
ownership.googleAuthenticator: An app on your device, with optional account backup.

moving.label: Moving accounts
moving.googleAuthenticator: Use account backup or device-transfer tools.

flow.title: Stay local. Move only when it helps.
flow.description: The same product supports private ownership, optional encrypted hosting, and persistent team access—without a silent sync in between.

client.title: Start on your device

encrypted.title: Choose a cloud transition

authorized.title: Share with governance

mobilePwa.title: Keep it on your phone

boundary.title: Readable authenticator data stays in your hands.

accessMetadata.title: Governed sharing
